name: Lunagaron
description: (Tag:fighter)(Tag:ice)(Tag:large-size)Lunagaron is a powerful frozen werewolf-like Fanged Wyvern and born apex predator. It crushes armored foes like tin cans and runs on walls with extreme agility. It supercools air via a special organ, expelling supercooled mist and coating itself in heat-resistant ice, and can enter a stronger bipedal berserk form by halting thermoregulation.
